question: How many deities are worshipped in Kharchi Puja of Tripura?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kharchi Puja** is one of the most important festivals celebrated in **Tripura**.
 
• It is a **week-long festival** and is usually observed in the **month of July.**
 
• The festival is centred around the** worship of Chaturdasa Devata**, the ancestral deity of the Tripuri people.
 
• It is also said to have been **influenced by the Brahmanical Hindus.**
 
• The **14 deities worshipped** during Kharchi Puja are Lord Shiva, Goddess Kali, Lord Ganesha, Lord Kartikeya, Goddess Lakshmi, Goddess Saraswati, Lord Vishnu, Lord Brahma, Lord Yama, Lord Agni, Lord Vayu, Lord Nirriti, Lord Varuna, and Lord Kubera. 
 
• **“Chantai”** or the **chief priest** chants mantras and his assistant sacrifices the animals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
